_readme: passwordHash = SHA-256 hex of "<username in lowercase>:<password>" (to make one: open the browser console on any page and run  crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', new TextEncoder().encode('admin:newpassword')).then(b => console.log([...new Uint8Array(b)].map(x => x.toString(16).padStart(2,'0')).join('')))  ). Replace the sample accounts before you share the app. role: admin (can delete and clear all data) or staff (can add and update entries). Set active:false to block a user. On GitHub Pages this file is public, so it keeps casual visitors out but is not strong security.
